seeded_failure.symptom: The application service crashes on restart after the log archival task completes.
seeded_failure.cause: The script created a replacement /var/log/app/current.log owned by root:root with 0644 access, preventing appuser from writing.
seeded_failure.fix: Execute chown appuser:appuser /var/log/app/current.log and restart the service via systemctl restart app.
